gaps: P0: none; P2: no candidates; P5: only tiny low-resolution stereo halves (#19, #20) with vague dates, and #17/#18 are not Valencia (#18 is Alicante)
notes: Guesdon (#5): the file name and description say 1830s (from a website), but Guesdon’s Spanish bird’s-eye series dates from the 1850s (his Barcelona view in this batch is dated 1856) and the print shows a smoking railway-era chimney, so labeled ‘1850s’. If that correction is not accepted, use #9 (Plaza de la Seo with the cathedral and Micalet, color photochrom, 1890) or #13 (Esplugas panorama from a tower, 1888–92) for P4 instead. A second P4 view was not added because the photochroms (1890) are less than 40 years after the 1850s.
